sources.description: With their 152nd overall selection in the 5th round of the 2026 NFL Draft, the Denver Broncos trade up and select NC State TE Justin Joly The Athletic’s Dane Brugler had Justin Joly as his TE5 in this draft and had a 3rd/4th round grade on him.
